node.title: The three-petal LS6 atom is a gcd-trivial sub-balance master split flat
node.statement: Every nonempty official rate-half M=4,t=3 guarded LS6 atom injects into an unpunctured full-domain split-flat section P intersect D_j(H) with locator degree j=2ell-a, projective dimension r=ell-2a+1, codimension ell+a-1, exact root threshold j, and flat-wide common gcd one. It satisfies j-2r=3a-2>=1 and binom(n,j)/Q^(j-r)<=2^(-3ell-4), where Q is the field generated by the domain and flat coefficients. Pure multiplicative pullbacks occur only at M|gcd(n,j), so they are absent for odd a. This is a descriptor and route reduction, not master flatness or an FPC5 payment.
